This test checks the "Create variable" quick fix in contexts where the
generated declaration does not compile.

The golden outputs below record the current, broken behavior.
See golang/go#81808.

-- interface.go --
package a

func f(...any) {}

func _() {
	f(undefinedInterface) //@quickfix("undefinedInterface", re"(undeclared|undefined)", interface)
}
-- @interface/interface.go --
@@ -6 +6 @@
+	undefinedInterface := nil
-- pointer.go --
package a

func _() {
	var p *int
	p = undefinedPointer //@quickfix("undefinedPointer", re"(undeclared|undefined)", pointer)
	_ = p
}
-- @pointer/pointer.go --
@@ -5 +5 @@
+	undefinedPointer := nil
-- field.go --
package a

type S struct{ s string }

func _() {
	_ = S{s: undefinedField} //@quickfix("undefinedField", re"(undeclared|undefined)", field)
}
-- @field/field.go --
@@ -6 +6 @@
+	undefinedField := 0
-- type.go --
package a

func _() {
	_ = undefinedType{} //@quickfix("undefinedType", re"(undeclared|undefined)", type)
}
-- @type/type.go --
@@ -4 +4 @@
+	undefinedType := 0
